headline: TSMC PUTS UP TO
**$1B** IN AI LABS
cover.hook_pick_reason: The up-to $1 billion and the two names (OpenAI and Anthropic, shown on slide 1) are fully backed by slides 1 and 2. The own-chips option is backed by slide 4 but hides the investment. The $500M option is backed by slide 2 but is a smaller number. No reader-impact hook: the articles state no direct effect on ordinary readers (what they pay, use or risk); they cover who is investing and why.

slides.title: A chipmaker bets up to $1B
body: **TSMC**, the world's largest contract chipmaker, will invest up to **$1 billion** in OpenAI and Anthropic, both of which are developing their own AI chips.

slides.title: Up to $500 million each
body: TSMC's board approved up to **$500 million** for Anthropic shares and up to **$500 million** for OpenAI preferred stock on Nov. 10.

slides.title: Anthropic is in its IPO process
body: The decision comes while Anthropic runs its IPO process. TSMC would buy its shares at the IPO offering price.

slides.title: Both labs are building chips
body: OpenAI unveiled an in-house AI inference chip in June, developed with **Broadcom**. Anthropic said in August it was forming a team to design a chip optimized for Claude.

slides.title: TSMC is running hot
body: TSMC reported its **sixth straight quarter** of record profit. It says demand for AI chips exceeds its production capacity.

facts.text: TSMC is the world's largest foundry and will invest up to $1 billion (about 1.34 trillion won) in OpenAI and Anthropic, both developing their own AI chips to reduce reliance on outside chipmakers.
TSMC's board approved on the 10th up to $500 million for Anthropic shares and up to $500 million for OpenAI preferred stock.
Anthropic is running its IPO process; TSMC would buy its shares at the IPO offering price.
OpenAI unveiled its in-house AI inference chip in June, co-developed with Broadcom.
Anthropic said in August it was forming a team to design a chip optimized for Claude.
TSMC announced last month six consecutive quarters of record profit and says demand exceeds production capacity.

caption:
